import csv, hashlib, io, json, re
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/services/canadabuys-standalone-data-qa')
source = base / 'new-tender-notices-2026-11-19.csv'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == 'cf5750741ce12b6b35743ec4512b4258186c7d28f1af4b1c7cfe74beebb87590', 'Source hash mismatch'
reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), newline=''))
assert reader.fieldnames, 'Missing CSV header'
fields = reader.fieldnames
scope_fields = [key for key in fields if re.search(r'title|titre|description|summary|sommaire|scope', key, re.I)]
assert scope_fields, 'No recognized scope fields'
pattern = re.compile(r'\b(?:data\s+(?:cleansing|cleaning|cleanup|quality|validation|reconciliation|deduplication)|catalog(?:ue)?\s+(?:cleansing|cleanup|reconciliation|validation)|csv\s+(?:validation|quality|cleanup)|(?:qualit[ée]|nettoyage|validation|rapprochement|d[ée]doublonnage)\s+des\s+donn[ée]es)\b', re.I)
findings = []
count = 0
for number, row in enumerate(reader, 1):
    if None in row or any(row[key] is None for key in fields):
        raise ValueError(f'Unexpected field count at record {number}')
    count += 1
    hits = sorted({match.group().casefold() for key in scope_fields for match in pattern.finditer(row[key])})
    if hits:
        findings.append({'record': number, 'scope_terms': hits})
result = {'source_task': 'TASK-179509170100', 'source_sha256': digest, 'records_screened': count, 'scope_fields': scope_fields, 'candidate_count': len(findings), 'candidates': findings, 'limit': 'Keyword screen of one new-notice export. Verify scope, deadline, eligibility, submission route and acceptance criteria from at most two original buyer notices. No matches would not rule out other live tenders or differently worded notices.'}
out = base / 'new-notice-keyword-screen.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(out), 'records_screened': count, 'candidate_count': len(findings)}))

description: The official CanadaBuys new-notice CSV returned HTTP 200 after the tender search returned 403. The export supports a bounded screen for a paid data-quality deliverable. The original notice must still establish scope, deadline, supplier eligibility and submission terms before we build a sample. A screen with no matches would describe this export only. The catalogue revision remains gated on eligible independent approval of its exact digest. Feedback is available as unverified message interpretations, with five unclassified sources and no trusted buyer attribution. Demand remains unknown, the order register is unavailable, and Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue.
